edit.description: Edit & upload: native region selection, then the on-demand editor. Optional; when absent it inherits the region output route with no hotkey.

record.description: Edit & upload: native region selection, then the on-demand editor. Optional; when absent it inherits the region output route with no hotkey.

monitor.description: Capture monitor: the monitor under the pointer, at its native size. Optional; when absent it copies the desktop output route with no hotkey.

repeat.description: Repeat last region: a hotkey only. It captures the rectangle of the last region capture again, with the region action's output. Optional; when absent it has no hotkey.

text.description: Copy text from region: a hotkey only. It copies the text and QR codes in a selected region and stores nothing, so it has no destination, archive or naming. Optional; when absent it has no hotkey.

keepUploads.description: Save a local copy of new captures and imports, independently of upload routing. With no destination and this disabled, the action is rejected before acquisition.

fileTemplate.description: Literal text and filename tokens only; SettingsService also validates each rendered filename. Time tokens use local action time.

captureTemplate.description: Literal text and filename tokens only; SettingsService also validates each rendered filename. Time tokens use local action time.

imageTemplate.description: Literal text and filename tokens only; SettingsService also validates each rendered filename. Time tokens use local action time.

textTemplate.description: Literal text and filename tokens only; SettingsService also validates each rendered filename. Time tokens use local action time.

recordingTemplate.description: Literal text and filename tokens only; SettingsService also validates each rendered filename. Time tokens use local action time.

maxFileBytes.description: Largest imported file. Bytes, "auto" (no byte limit of put.gd's own) or null for no limit. The destination's maximum object size and free disk space, less a system reserve of min(15% of the filesystem, 4 GiB) and at least 1 GiB, always apply. A saved 2147483648 (the former default) reads as "auto".

maxBatchBytes.description: Largest combined batch. Bytes, "auto" (no byte limit of put.gd's own) or null for no limit. The destination's maximum object size and free disk space, less a system reserve of min(15% of the filesystem, 4 GiB) and at least 1 GiB, always apply. A saved 2147483648 (the former default) reads as "auto".

pendingArtifactBytes.description: Most acquired content waiting on disk. Bytes, "auto" (no byte limit of put.gd's own) or null for no limit. The destination's maximum object size and free disk space, less a system reserve of min(15% of the filesystem, 4 GiB) and at least 1 GiB, always apply. A saved 2147483648 (the former default) reads as "auto".

pendingImageBytes.description: Total decoded image bytes admitted for queued/encoding jobs; released after persistence or cancellation. Does not bound total RSS.

recordingAnimationSeconds.description: Retained duration allowed for animated GIF/WebP recording exports.

recordingAnimationEdge.description: Output long edge allowed for animated GIF/WebP recording exports; set maxEdge on the recording to downscale explicitly.

logDays.description: Days to keep persistent log files (docs/design/diagnostics.md). Omitted means 14.

logBytes.description: Total bytes of persistent log files; the oldest files go first. Omitted means 50 MiB.

uploadClipboardBehavior.description: Copy every successful upload link individually as it becomes available, or one ordered list after overlapping uploads settle. Omitted legacy settings use each_link.

regionSelectionMode.description: How region capture shows the screen while you drag. live keeps the desktop updating (an open menu must close first); screenshot_first captures every monitor before the selector opens and cuts the region from that frozen frame, so open menus are included. Recording region selection is always live. Omitted means live.

captureDelaySeconds.description: Seconds the tray and the dashboard wait before a region, window, monitor or desktop capture, a repeat of the last region, or Capture region & edit. A countdown shows meanwhile and can be cancelled. Hotkey captures are immediate unless captureDelayShortcuts is true, and session requests pass their own delaySeconds. Omitted means 0.

captureDelayShortcuts.description: Whether captures started by a hotkey also wait captureDelaySeconds. Omitted means false: hotkey captures are immediate.

recordingFrameRate.description: Frames per second for screen recordings that don't ask for a rate. 60 is smoother and takes about twice the conversion and encoding work; while a recording runs, put.gd lowers the rate (60 to 30, 30 to 15) when the computer can't keep up. Omitted means 30.

recordingMicrophone.description: The microphone toggle on the recording bar, remembered between recordings started from the tray, the dashboard or the hotkey. The microphone is opened only while the toggle is on and released when the recording stops. Omitted means off.

recordingMicrophoneDevice.description: The input device recordings narrate from, by its sound-server source name as recording.microphones lists it. Empty or omitted means the system default input. The monitor of an output is never used as a microphone.

recordingClickHighlights.description: Draw a ring at the pointer on each click in recordings, where the desktop offers the clicks (recording.capabilities reports it). Omitted means off.

fileManagerFolders.description: How a folder chosen with Upload with put.gd in a file manager uploads: zip makes one <folder name>.zip and one link; files uploads every file in it (symlinks skipped). In files mode the file limit (limits.maxFiles, up to 10,000) counts the expanded files. Omitted means zip.

fileManagerMenu.description: Whether the AppImage adds Upload with put.gd to your file managers' right-click menus (per-user files it writes and removes). DEB and RPM installs add system-wide entries that are always on. Omitted means true.

unlockCredentialsAtStartup.description: Read saved keychain credentials once when put.gd starts. A locked desktop keyring shows its own unlock prompt then; uploads and hotkeys never unlock. Omitted means true.

editorRecentColors.description: Custom colors recently picked in the editor, most recent first. Written by put.gd.

textRecognitionLanguages.description: Languages Copy text reads, as Tesseract language identifiers (eng, deu, chi_sim), in order. A language whose data is not installed is skipped when another loads. Omitted means the desktop locale's language when its data is installed, then English.

appearance.description: The settings and history windows' colours. Omitted means {"theme": "system"}.

theme.description: system follows the desktop's light or dark preference live; dark and light fix the scheme. The tray icon follows the panel's colour either way.

accent.description: Reserved for a custom accent colour (phase 2 of #60). null is the built-in accent.

overrides.description: Reserved for per-colour overrides of each scheme (phase 2 of #60). Both stay empty until then.

updates.description: The daily check for a newer version (#293). It sends one request to app.put.gd with no identifying details and compares versions on this computer. Omitted means {"check": true, "channel": "build"}.

check.description: Check once a day. Stable builds notify once per new version; nightly builds only show it in Settings. Development and source builds never check.

channel.description: build follows this installation's own channel (release candidates follow stable); stable or nightly choose one.

debugLogging.description: Keep debug records in the persistent log. put.gd turns this off again 24 hours after it was turned on. AWS SDK trace logging is never enabled.

packageFolder.description: The folder Settings → Create diagnostics package last saved to. Omitted or null means <archive root>/diagnostics. Written by put.gd.

title: put.gd non-secret configuration

objectPrefix.description: UTF-8 byte length is limited to 1022; adapter enforces the final 1024-byte object key limit.

publicUrlBase.description: Absolute HTTPS URL without credentials/query/fragment, or literal-loopback HTTP. An encoded base path is preserved. Null derives from effective S3 addressing.

addressing.description: auto uses virtual only for AWS hosts and undotted bucket names; path supports dotted buckets; virtual rejects dotted names and literal IP endpoints.

b2Settings.description: Backblaze B2 native API destination (#282). The provider validator is authoritative.

apiUrl.description: B2 authorization endpoint: HTTPS, or literal-loopback HTTP for local fixtures.

bucket.description: Existing B2 bucket name; names starting with b2- are reserved.

linkMode.description: public: the friendly URL of an allPublic bucket. authorized: a download-authorization token for exactly the file name.

publicUrlBase.description: Optional link domain, for public buckets only.

customHttpRow.description: A header, URL parameter or form field. A secret row carries its name only: its value is in the credential store.

customHttpSettings.description: Custom HTTP uploader destination (#1361): one request, described by hand or imported from a ShareX .sxcu file. The provider validator is authoritative.

requestUrl.description: Where uploads are sent: HTTPS, or HTTP to a literal loopback host, without a query (use parameters). {filename} may fill part of the path. Empty until the destination is set up.

allowInsecureHttp.description: Allow plain HTTP to a host other than loopback. Files and credentials then travel unencrypted.

accepts.description: What the destination takes; file covers everything.

fileFormName.description: The multipart field that carries the file; empty sends form fields only.

secrets.description: Named stored values with no row of their own, used as {secret:secrets/name} in the request URL or the deletion URL. Names only.

data.description: The JSON or XML body text; empty when dataSecret is true.

dataSecret.description: The body text is a secret kept in the credential store.

responseUrl.description: Where the reply holds the link, such as {json:files[0].url}; empty when the whole reply is the link.

deletionUrl.description: Optional deletion URL; without one an upload cannot be deleted from History.

errorMessage.description: Optional text shown when the server refuses an upload.

folderName.description: Optional display hint for folderUid, limited to 255 UTF-8 bytes by the provider validator. Uploads use folderUid.

description: SettingsService is authoritative for profile references, uniqueness, hotkeys and registered provider validation.
